# hsnlabs

> Forward Deployed Engineering boutique solving why enterprise AI agents fail in production. We handle the complete Agentic Development Life Cycle (ADLC): executable business ontologies, zero-trust infrastructure, stateful orchestration, and continuous evaluation in production. A clean machine-readable Markdown version of every page is available by appending `index.md` to the directory path (e.g., `https://hsnlabs.ai/index.md`, `https://hsnlabs.ai/bootcamp/index.md`, `https://hsnlabs.ai/en/index.md`, `https://hsnlabs.ai/en/bootcamp/index.md`). The primary site at root (`/`) is in Brazilian Portuguese (`pt-BR`), with the full English mirror under `/en/`.

## Canonical Positioning & Value Proposition
- Overview (PT-BR): https://hsnlabs.ai/
- Overview (EN): https://hsnlabs.ai/en/
hsnlabs is an enterprise AI transformation partner operationalizing autonomous agents over legacy systems, starting with the Agentic Bootcamp backed by US$ 5,000 in cloud, AI tokens, and tooling.
- Escape the PoC Graveyard: https://hsnlabs.ai/#market-reality
46% of corporate AI proofs of concept were scrapped before production in 2025 (S&P Global Market Intelligence). Connecting AI to legacy systems without architectural redesign only creates technical debt.

## Entry Engagement: Agentic Bootcamp
- Bootcamp Deployment Protocol (PT-BR): https://hsnlabs.ai/bootcamp/
- Bootcamp Deployment Protocol (EN): https://hsnlabs.ai/en/bootcamp/
We embed a senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) inside your operation to validate data access, map executable business ontologies (Code to Spec), deploy a sandbox prototype on LangGraph, and deliver an audited production Business Case. Qualified enterprise accounts unlock 100% Performance Rebate credited toward the production rollout contract plus US$ 5,000 in ecosystem credits across Google Cloud, Snowflake, Braintrust, and LangChain.

## Why Agents Fail & Core Failure Modes
- Why Agents Fail (PT-BR): https://hsnlabs.ai/#services
- Why Agents Fail (EN): https://hsnlabs.ai/en/#services
1. Legacy and Fragmented Data: Domain-adapted pipelines and schema normalization over legacy ERPs.
2. Static Ontology: Executable business ontologies replacing hardcoded schemas and brittle prompts.
3. Governance & Compliance: Deterministic code-level guards and strict audit logs guaranteeing transactional integrity.
4. Complex Enterprise ADLC: 12-component enterprise agentic architecture blueprint (`/architecture.html`).

## Ecosystem & Platform Alliances
- LangChain & LangGraph Architecture: https://hsnlabs.ai/langchain/ | https://hsnlabs.ai/en/langchain/
Independent agentic engineering with LangChain and LangGraph in production since 2022, featuring stateful StateGraph orchestration, LangSmith evaluation suites, and sovereign VPC runtimes.
- Snowflake AI Data Cloud Architecture: https://hsnlabs.ai/snowflake/ | https://hsnlabs.ai/en/snowflake/
Operationalizing deterministic LangGraph state machines and executable business ontologies directly over the Snowflake AI Data Cloud with zero-copy governance and row-level security.
- Braintrust Evals & CI/CD: https://hsnlabs.ai/braintrust/ | https://hsnlabs.ai/en/braintrust/
Eliminating stochastic prompt regressions in production with Braintrust continuous evaluation suites, CI/CD regression gates, and trace observability.
- Enterprise MCP Servers: https://hsnlabs.ai/mcp/ | https://hsnlabs.ai/en/mcp/
Private, zero-trust Model Context Protocol servers connecting deep agents to SAP, TOTVS, and relational databases inside your cloud perimeter.
